tools.name: get_factory_overview
tools.description: Who HLN Apparel is: founding year, quality standard, audits, shipping terms, scale and key page links.

tools.name: list_product_categories
tools.description: Garment categories HLN makes, each with typical fabrics, GSM range, MOQ, sample time, bulk lead time, size range, customisation options and the category page URL.

tools.name: lookup_hs_codes
tools.description: Suggested HS codes for garments, the US HTS line, the US general duty rate and the total rate for goods made in China (Section 301 plus other China tariffs), with the CBP ruling each row is based on.

tools.name: convert_fabric_weight
tools.description: Convert fabric weight between GSM and ounces per square yard, and list garments typically made at that weight.

tools.name: preview_inquiry
tools.description: Step 1 of 2. Checks a quote request for HLN Apparel and returns a summary plus a confirmation_token. Sends nothing. Show the summary to the buyer and ask them to confirm before calling submit_inquiry. Only use details the buyer actually gave; ask for missing name, email, quantity or requirements ins

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Step 2 of 2. Sends the confirmed quote request to the HLN sales team and emails the buyer a receipt. Call it only after the buyer explicitly confirmed the preview_inquiry summary, with exactly the same fields and its confirmation_token. Attachment links are downloaded and stored privately.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "preview_inquiry" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Step 1 of 2. Checks a quote request for HLN Apparel and returns a summary plus a confirmation_token. Sends nothing. Show the summary to the buyer and ask them t…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_product_categories · Public sink: preview_inquiry, submit_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_product_categories · Public sink: preview_inquiry, submit_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
